description: This file defines the H4Parser class, which is responsible for parsing H4 protocol packets used in Bluetooth communication. It includes callback type definitions, parser state management, and constants for packet preamble sizes and offsets.

classes.name: H4Parser
classes.description: A class that parses H4 protocol packets and manages internal state, invoking callbacks upon packet completion.

methods.name: H4Parser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with callback functions and optional recovery mode.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Consumes a buffer of bytes to parse packets, returning true if successful.

methods.name: BytesRequested
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bytes the parser needs to process in the current state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser to its initial state.

methods.name: CurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the parser.

methods.name: EnableRecovery
methods.description: Enables recovery mode for the parser.

methods.name: DisableRecovery
methods.description: Disables recovery mode for the parser.
